title: Act: Name the resolveKey type in effectContext
summary: Export ResolveKey alias used by createPhaserEffectContext
description: Export a ResolveKey type alias so tests and BootScene share the second-argument contract of createPhaserEffectContext.
acceptance_criteria: Given effectContext.ts, When imported, Then ResolveKey is exported as (id: string) => string
Given createPhaserEffectContext, When called, Then it still takes (scene, resolveKey)
definition_of_done: ResolveKey exported and used in the signature

steps.action: Add an exported type alias ResolveKey above createPhaserEffectContext and use it for the resolveKey parameter.
steps.code:
export type ResolveKey = (id: string) => string;
resolveKey: (id: string) => string, -> resolveKey: ResolveKey,
steps.expected: The signature is unchanged in shape and the alias is exported
